Banks helped ASX snap three-day losing streak, providing near-term support to ^AXJO
Fed's Waller signals September hold, easing global rate-hike bets; Wall Street nears record highs on Mag 7 strength
Persian Gulf tanker incidents raise oil supply risk; TMK Energy gas rates surge on Mongolian drilling
Macarthur clears WA iron ore bulk test hurdle; Lindian signs 20-year Kazakhstan rare earths offtake; gold exploration active (Dalaroo, Lake Victoria, PLC)

sectors.trend: Banks (CBA, NAB, ANZ, WBC) supported ASX by snapping 3-day losing streak, but face mounting credit risk from 18-year high mortgage stress and record house price decline forecasts. Home loan applications down 15% post-budget signals demand contraction.
sectors.implications: Near-term earnings support from higher NIMs offset by rising provision needs. CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face a structural headwind if house prices fall 10% as predicted. Watch credit loss provisions in upcoming results.

sectors.trend: Macarthur clears WA iron ore bulk test; Lindian secures 20-year Kazakhstan rare earths offtake; active gold exploration (Dalaroo, Lake Victoria, PLC, Critical Resources). Chinese solar overtaking coal pressures thermal coal demand long-term.
sectors.implications: Iron ore (BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX) supported by Macarthur's WA progress but faces structural demand shift. Rare earths (Lindian) and gold (Dalaroo, Lake Victoria) offer diversification. Coal (WDS.AX, LSE.AX) faces secular headwind from Chinese solar transition.

sectors.trend: TMK Energy gas rates surge on Mongolian drilling; Persian Gulf tanker incidents spike oil risk premium; energy transition costs 'running off rails'; One Nation pressures to keep coal plant open.
sectors.implications: Short-term oil/gas upside for WDS.AX, AWE.AX, GWO.AX on supply disruption. Long-term transition cost overhang pressures thermal generators. TMK Energy (TMK.AX) benefits from gas rate surge.

sectors.trend: Ozempic maker (Novo Nordisk) in trouble, tablet alternatives emerging; regional doctors strike over poor conditions; childcare chain shutting centres.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX relatively insulated but watch GLP-1 competitive dynamics. Regional doctor strike pressures HIC.AX, IAG.AX (health insurance). Childcare closures hit REITs with childcare exposure.

sectors.trend: Record house price fall forecasts and 10% decline predictions create severe headwind for residential REITs and property-linked equities.
sectors.implications: OGP.AX, VMC.AX, SSW.AX face valuation pressure. Commercial REITs (ICP.AX, DGL.AX) less directly impacted but rate sensitivity remains elevated.

Energy transition cost overhang and Chinese solar/coal crossover
AUD inflation dynamics: potential AUD strength on inflation data
Political pressure on Treasurer Chalmers over housing and debt

risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce residential REIT and property-linked exposure; favour banks with diversified loan books; monitor NAB/CBA provision guidance

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA fourth rate hike amid weak GDP
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge rate sensitivity via short-duration bonds; favour fixed-income over equities; watch RBA statement for forward guidance
Energy equities (WDS.AX, AWE.AX) offer hedge; monitor Brent crude; diversify away from rate-sensitive growth
Favour cash-generative large caps (BHP.AX, CSL.AX, CBA.AX); avoid high-debt small caps
Monitor government subsidy policy; favour companies with clear transition revenue (Lindian, TMK)

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold and rare earths miners as inflation/hedge plays
opportunities.rationale: Inflation risk, AUD volatility, and geopolitical tension support gold; Lindian's 20-year offtake de-risks rare earths revenue

opportunities.recommendation: Selective energy exposure on supply disruption
opportunities.rationale: Persian Gulf tanker incidents and TMK gas rate surge create near-term upside for gas/oil producers

opportunities.recommendation: Maintain large-cap bank exposure for yield and ASX support
opportunities.rationale: Banks snapped 3-day losing streak; higher NIMs offset near-term provision risk; CBA/NAB remain ASX anchors

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce residential REIT and property exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Record house price fall forecasts and 10% decline risk create severe downside for property valuations

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge rate risk with short-duration fixed income
defensive_moves.rationale: Fourth RBA hike looming; mortgage stress at 18-year highs; GDP weakness limits rate-cut offset

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight thermal coal on Chinese solar transition
defensive_moves.rationale: Chinese solar capacity passing coal is a structural demand headwind for Australian thermal coal exporters

market_outlook.short_term: ASX faces headwinds from RBA rate hike fears, housing correction, and mortgage stress. Banks provide floor support but credit risk builds. Global tailwind from Fed hold and Wall Street strength offers partial offset. Expect choppy, range-bound ^AXJO with sector rotation into defensives and commodities.
market_outlook.long_term: Productivity 'bad to worse' and debt sustainability concerns cap medium-term equity returns. Energy transition and Chinese solar/coal shift reshape materials sector. Housing correction may take 12-18 months to stabilise. Gold, rare earths, and gas offer structural outperformance.
